rows.quote: The test fixture was mounted inside the vacuum can of a closed-cycle helium gas refrigerator and fed a signal by an HPgSI7B S-parameter test set. The temperature was controlled using a Lake Shore DRC 91C temperature controller.
rows.reasoning: The paper's own apparatus description states the brass filter fixture was cooled in the vacuum can of a closed-cycle helium gas refrigerator with a Lake Shore controller. The documented cooling method is a bulk closed-cycle cryocooler, not a microfabricated Joule-Thomson microcooler; no micro-JT stage is part of this documented configuration. (OCR renders the test-set model as 'HPgSI7B', likely HP 8517B; quoted as extracted.)

rows.quote: were tested using a Hewlett-Packard 8510C Automated Network Analyzer (ANA). Both were mounted on brass test fixtures with coaxial pin launchers.
rows.value_as_printed: HP 8510C network analyzer; 4.0 GHz bandpass filters
rows.reasoning: The documented configuration is a coaxial microwave S-parameter test fixture (HP 8510C network analyzer, coaxial pin launchers) for 4.0 GHz YBCO bandpass filters (abstract: 'bandpass filters at 4.0 GHz'). It is a microwave insertion-loss measurement setup, not a terahertz detector system; the paper describes no THz detector, so stable THz detector operation is not a function of this configuration.
